checks: Chapter content is searched locally, including body text and a no-results state.
Mouse, keyboard shortcuts, and a standard Gamepad API fixture navigate the tutorial.
Every gray help button focuses its specified chapter and returns exact scroll and focus.
A locally imported city keeps its unsaved manual spawn and collision type after visiting help.
Flight settings open with three controls. Copy Seed remains available and the legacy gen=2 link loads its world.
An invalid custom HTTP endpoint shows a configuration error and clears the typed fixture key.
